name: apk_actuator
description: Autonomous Android APK Actuator & Bridge. Controls, automates, and interacts with any Android application running in the Flowork Micro-VM Subsystem. Features: autonomous app awareness (auto-searches and installs missing apps from Play Store/CDN), app lifecycle (launch, stop, list, search, install, uninstall), semantic UI introspection (dump_ui with bounding boxes and auto-centered clickable targets), interactive actions (click by text/desc/id/coords, type_text, directional scroll/flick for short video drama/reels/feed), hardware navigation keys (back, home, enter, etc.), media upload pipeline (pushes videos/images into Android gallery and triggers instant media scan for social uploading), and screenshot capture.

package.description: Target package name, alias (e.g. 'melolo', 'tiktok', 'capcut'), or local APK/XAPK file path.

auto_install.description: Automatically search and install the app from store if not currently installed. Defaults to true.

query.description: Search query for Android apps on Google Play Store & APK CDN.

text.description: Text to click via semantic search, or text to type into active input field.

desc.description: Content description of target element to click.

resource_id.description: Resource ID of target element to click.

direction.description: Direction to flick/scroll. 'up' advances to next video/drama episode; 'down' returns to previous.

key.description: Key name or keycode to press: 'back', 'home', 'enter', 'tab', 'app_switch', 'volume_up', 'volume_down', 'play_pause', 'del'.

file_path.description: Absolute host file path of video/image to push to Android gallery or APK file to install.

output_path.description: Host path to save empirical screenshot (default: '/dev/shm/flowork_apk_screen.png').
